Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 447 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State Health Officer to provide written approval of a county health officers orders or directives related to a pandemic or outbreak of disease. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Paul W. Lee, Chair
Health
